name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (CSSS)
provider: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education

rules.quote: Students who are above 80 th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream from a particular Board of Examination in Class XII
Having family income upto Rs. 4.5 lakh per annum
Students pursuing regular course (not correspondence or distance mode)

rules.value: diploma students and gap-year students not eligible
rules.quote: Students who had taken a drop after 12 th class are not eligible under the scheme.

rules.value: no other scholarship or fee reimbursement
rules.quote: Not receiving any other scholarship or fee reimbursement of any kind

rules.value: renewal needs 50% marks and 75% attendance; max 5 years
rules.quote: Student must secure at least 50% marks and maintain adequate attendance of at least 75%.

rules.value: 50% slots for girls; SC 15%, ST 7.5%, OBC 27%, 5% PwBD horizontal
rules.quote: merit list is drawn based on gender (50 boys: 50 girls), stream (3-Science: 1-Commerce: 3-Humanities), Category (SC-15 %, ST-7.5 % and OBC-27 %)

amount.text: Rs 12,000 p.a. for first 3 years of graduation; Rs 20,000 p.a. at PG level and in 4th/5th year of professional courses
amount.quote: The rate of scholarship is Rs. 12,000/- per annum at Graduation level for first three years of College and University courses and Rs. 20,000/- per annum at Post-Graduation level.

documents.name: Income certificate (fresh applicants only)
documents.quote: Income certificate will be required onlyforthe fresh applicants

deadline.text: NSP 2026-27 lists this scheme for renewal only; student application close 31-10-2026 (registers/nsp_central_2026_27.csv)
